newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: MAURITIUS RUPEE STEADY VS DOLLAR, FIRMS VS STG.
newsitem.headline: MAURITIUS RUPEE STEADY VS DOLLAR, FIRMS VS STG.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was steady against the dollar and firmed against sterling on Friday, reflecting international market trends, forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 21.852 to the dollar from 21.856 on Thursday, and at 34.7175 to the pound sterling from 35.0655.
"The central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Thursday afternoon at the prevailing interbank rate," one dealer said.
